metaphor: a vanilla-cream cord connecting a plain server endpoint to a proxy endpoint
rules: The cord is the primary VanillaCord motif.
Use cream/ivory to express both vanilla flavor and plain/stock Minecraft.
Keep Bridge out of the user-facing identity; it is an implementation dependency.
Anchor the cord visibly between endpoints; avoid isolated looped silhouettes.
Use Minecraft-adjacent block geometry without copying Minecraft textures, logos, fonts, mobs, or UI.
Keep claims factual, brief, and traceable to repository contracts.
